title: cassia linearifolia var. bradei
intro: Cassia linearifolia var. bradei, commonly known as Brazilian senna, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, known for its medicinal properties and uses. The health benefits of Brazilian senna include its ability to act as a laxative, helping to relieve constipation and promote digestive regularity. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of Brazilian senna include anthraquinone glycosides, which are responsible for its laxative effects, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic compounds.
